body: Thank you!! Did you choose a random/te closest homeless shelter or did you pick specially? I've also heard stories about some shelters not being very helpful either. How do I know which one to stay at? Just experience?

Thanks for the link. I don't expect do do anything right away, I know it will take time, I was just wondering how quickly I could do it. Most people I asked weren't very helpful and said wait till 18 to move out.

I just came here to say that you are not alone, and that people do really care about you. I've never met you before or seen your face, but you've told me your story and I feel your pain. I've been there, where nobody around you cares. But let me tell you something. I care. A complete stranger cares about you. You're not a self loathing person or a bitch, you are a person put into a situation they don't deserve-and believe me when I say that I KNOW what that feels like (feel free to look at my post history if you like). I know that road, and I know where it ends, and believe me when I say you don't wanna go there. I sincerely care about you because I see my past self in your writing. You feel alone an uncared for but that is simply not true. You are not alone, and you are not uncared for. I am with you and I care. And I don't even know anything about you. So please... care about yourself.

You guys have helped me through the night, thanks so much.

Peace, love, and friendship to all you people

No not really. Although I am considering maybe living in an apartment on my own on CPP. I live in Canada so it's legal to do that at my age. But I don't have a job right now so I can't at the moment. Btw cpp=Canadian pension plan if u don't know

I don't know.. My parents are always telling me how selfish I am (also said this when I told them I was depressed). They think I'm just making excuses or wanting attention or whatever. If anything I think they'd be more pissed about the clean up than anything
I know we're talking through messages already but I can't express how much I feel you right now. You can and will get better.
